body:
A message to a design run can carry notes, and the agent receives exactly which elements each one means. This is the server side; the panel is task "notes: add a note from the panel".

### Do

- A human's message to a design run may carry notes. A note is a design ID, one or more element IDs, and text (feature:afd9fe8bae36c59c).
- Refuse a note naming a missing design or an element that isn't in it, naming the element.
- The agent gets each note with its message, once, with each element's type and its place in the tree (its parents), so it can find the element without vision.
- A note is not kept on the design.
- Record the note's form in a decision, and in the design run reference.

### Acceptance

- Tests: a message with notes reaches the agent with each element's type and parents, an unknown element is refused, and nothing is written to the design.

### Left out

The panel, and notes from one agent to another.
title: notes: deliver notes to the design agent
